About us

Social media skills, taught with warmth & honesty.

The Digital Academy exists to make social media education accessible, practical and empowering — especially for women building something of their own.

Our story

It started with a simple frustration

Social media can open real doors — new customers, new income, a business that fits around your life. Yet so much of the advice online is rushed, confusing or designed to make you feel behind.

The Digital Academy was created to be the calm alternative: clear lessons, honest guidance and a supportive place to learn TikTok, Instagram, content creation, TikTok Shop and affiliate marketing — one manageable step at a time.

Whether you’re posting your very first video or ready to turn an audience into income, you’ll find a path here that respects your time, your pace and your ambition.

What we stand for

Our values

Accessible first

Plain language, clear structure and prices that respect real budgets. If a beginner can’t follow it, we rewrite it.

Practical always

Skills you can use the same day: film it, post it, list it, link it. Theory only where it genuinely helps.

Empowering by design

Confidence is a skill too. We teach the platforms — and the mindset to show up on them as yourself.

Our mission

“Learn the skills. Build the confidence. Create the opportunity.”

That sentence guides every course we write and every Sunday workshop we host. If you’re ready to begin your next chapter, we’d love to learn alongside you.

Good to know

Before you ask

Do I need experience to join a course?

Not at all. Most courses are written for complete beginners, and each one tells you clearly who it’s for and what you’ll be able to do by the end.

How do Sunday workshops work?

Book and pay online, receive your confirmation and Microsoft Teams joining link by email, then join live on the day. Sessions are small, practical and include time for your questions.

How do I access my course after buying?

Instantly. Your videos and downloadable materials appear in your secure student dashboard the moment you enrol — sign in any time, on any device.
